label: folio-assistant vocabulary (bootstrap only)
comment: Every class and property the folio knowledge graph projects, one node each. Generated by scripts/ns-export.ts; graph-typology definitions are read from the declaration registry rather than restated here.

@graph.label: Node
@graph.comment: One file, or one part of a file addressable by an IRI fragment, named by an IRI.
@graph.definition: One file, or one part of a file addressable by an IRI fragment, named by an IRI.

@graph.label: Reference
@graph.comment: A Node's naming of another Node by its IRI.
@graph.definition: A Node's naming of another Node by its IRI.

@graph.label: Node Schema
@graph.comment: A schema a Node can be checked against: a JSON Schema, or a published external schema such as BPMN's.
@graph.definition: A schema a Node can be checked against: a JSON Schema, or a published external schema such as BPMN's.

@graph.label: Node Kind
@graph.comment: A name paired with a Node Schema.
@graph.definition: A name paired with a Node Schema.

@graph.label: Subkind
@graph.comment: A Node Kind whose Node Schema requires everything another Node Kind's does, so every Node that satisfies it satisfies the other too.
@graph.definition: A Node Kind whose Node Schema requires everything another Node Kind's does, so every Node that satisfies it satisfies the other too.

@graph.label: Node Instance
@graph.comment: A Node that names its Node Kind, in `$schema` or front matter, and satisfies that kind's Node Schema.
@graph.definition: A Node that names its Node Kind, in `$schema` or front matter, and satisfies that kind's Node Schema.

@graph.label: Graph Typology
@graph.comment: A named set of Node Kinds.
@graph.definition: A named set of Node Kinds.

@graph.label: Declaration
@graph.comment: A JSON document, `<name>.json`, that gives a name and lists directory entries and file entries.
@graph.definition: A JSON document, `<name>.json`, that gives a name and lists directory entries and file entries.

@graph.label: Extension
@graph.comment: A field of a Declaration, or of one of its entries, that is not defined here. A reader that does not recognise the field ignores it, and the rest of the Declaration keeps its meaning.
@graph.definition: A field of a Declaration, or of one of its entries, that is not defined here. A reader that does not recognise the field ignores it, and the rest of the Declaration keeps its meaning.

@graph.label: Subgraph
@graph.comment: A directory entry of a Declaration: an id, a directory, and the Graph Typologies its Node Instances' kinds belong to.
@graph.definition: A directory entry of a Declaration: an id, a directory, and the Graph Typologies its Node Instances' kinds belong to.

@graph.label: Asset
@graph.comment: A file entry of a Declaration: one file about the repository itself, whose `role` field says what it is for.
@graph.definition: A file entry of a Declaration: one file about the repository itself, whose `role` field says what it is for.

@graph.label: Knowledge Graph
@graph.comment: The Node Schemas, Node Instances and Assets one Declaration lists, as of one version of the repository. Published as JSON-LD, the statements of each Subgraph's Node Instances form one named graph.
@graph.definition: The Node Schemas, Node Instances and Assets one Declaration lists, as of one version of the repository. Published as JSON-LD, the statements of each Subgraph's Node Instances form one named graph.

@graph.label: Dependency
@graph.comment: A Declaration's `needs` entry naming another Knowledge Graph. References may point from this graph's Node Instances into the named one, never back.
@graph.definition: A Declaration's `needs` entry naming another Knowledge Graph. References may point from this graph's Node Instances into the named one, never back.

@graph.label: Content
@graph.comment: Node Instances that describe the subject matter of a Knowledge Graph, such as records, documents, catalogues and their terms, rather than how to work with it.
@graph.definition: Node Instances that describe the subject matter of a Knowledge Graph, such as records, documents, catalogues and their terms, rather than how to work with it.

@graph.label: Task
@graph.comment: A unit of work, stated by what it needs to begin and what it produces.
@graph.definition: A unit of work, stated by what it needs to begin and what it produces.

@graph.label: Actor
@graph.comment: A person, an agent or a program that can carry out Tasks.
@graph.definition: A person, an agent or a program that can carry out Tasks.

@graph.label: Skill
@graph.comment: A Node Instance stating a responsibility an Actor carries out to complete a Task: as natural-language instructions to follow, as a contract to be tested against, or both.
@graph.definition: A Node Instance stating a responsibility an Actor carries out to complete a Task: as natural-language instructions to follow, as a contract to be tested against, or both.

@graph.label: Role
@graph.comment: A Node Instance naming a part an Actor takes on to carry out Tasks, and listing the Skills that part needs.
@graph.definition: A Node Instance naming a part an Actor takes on to carry out Tasks, and listing the Skills that part needs.

@graph.label: Process Node
@graph.comment: A BPMN flow node: an activity (a task or call activity), a gateway, or an event.
@graph.definition: A BPMN flow node: an activity (a task or call activity), a gateway, or an event.

@graph.label: Sequence Flow
@graph.comment: A directed connection in a BPMN process from one Process Node to the next.
@graph.definition: A directed connection in a BPMN process from one Process Node to the next.

@graph.label: Process
@graph.comment: A Node Instance holding a BPMN process that coordinates Tasks: its Process Nodes, joined by Sequence Flows, sit in lanes that each name a Role.
@graph.definition: A Node Instance holding a BPMN process that coordinates Tasks: its Process Nodes, joined by Sequence Flows, sit in lanes that each name a Role.

@graph.label: Harness
@graph.comment: A Knowledge Graph whose Subgraphs hold Skills, Roles or Processes: what an Actor uses to work with a Knowledge Graph, including itself.
@graph.definition: A Knowledge Graph whose Subgraphs hold Skills, Roles or Processes: what an Actor uses to work with a Knowledge Graph, including itself.

@graph.label: skills
@graph.comment: A Subgraph of Skills: the instructions an Actor follows to carry out a Task.
@graph.definition: A Subgraph of Skills: the instructions an Actor follows to carry out a Task.

@graph.label: schemas
@graph.comment: A Subgraph of Node Schemas: files that state the shape other files must have.
@graph.definition: A Subgraph of Node Schemas: files that state the shape other files must have.

@graph.label: scenarios
@graph.comment: A Subgraph of Roles: the responsibilities an Actor takes on, and who takes them on.
@graph.definition: A Subgraph of Roles: the responsibilities an Actor takes on, and who takes them on.

@graph.label: processes
@graph.comment: A Subgraph of Processes: BPMN diagrams that coordinate Tasks, and the decision tables their gateways compute from.
@graph.definition: A Subgraph of Processes: BPMN diagrams that coordinate Tasks, and the decision tables their gateways compute from.

@graph.label: models
@graph.comment: A Subgraph describing the language models an Actor may be: which languages each is good at, and whether a person checked.
@graph.definition: A Subgraph describing the language models an Actor may be: which languages each is good at, and whether a person checked.

@graph.title: folio-assistant vocabulary vocabulary
@graph.definition: Every class and property the vocabulary instance mints, one concept each.
